headword: {仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう}
reading: ちゅうかいてすうりょう

definitions.gloss: brokerage fee, agent's commission, intermediary fee
definitions.explanation: A fee paid to a broker or agent for facilitating a transaction, most commonly in real estate. In Japan, this typically refers to the fee paid to a real estate agent when renting or buying property.

examples.japanese: {仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: How much is the brokerage fee?

examples.japanese: {仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: To look for a property with no brokerage fee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賃貸|ちんたい}→賃貸：06081_chintai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一|いっ}か{月分|げつぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上限|じょうげん}→上限：11299_jougen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: By law, the brokerage fee for rentals is capped at one month's rent.

notes:
COMPONENTS: ⟦{仲介|ちゅうかい}→仲介：09718_chuukai⟧ (mediation/brokering) + ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (handling fee/commission).

In Japanese real estate, the {仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう} is one of the initial costs when renting an apartment, along with ⟦{敷金|しききん}→敷金：06079_shikikin⟧ (security deposit), ⟦{礼金|れいきん}→礼金：06080_reikin⟧ (key money), and the first month's rent.

For property purchases, the legal maximum is based on a sliding scale of the sale price. Some agents advertise {仲介手数料|ちゅうかいてすうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ (no commission) or ⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧ (half price) as a selling point.
